name: ai.reevi/find-buyers
title: Reevi: find buyers for exporters
description: Find companies that already buy your product, by product and country. Free, no key.

tools.name: find_buyers
tools.description: Find real companies that already buy a product, for an exporter or manufacturer. Give the product and the countries to sell to; returns named buyer companies (name, website, country, fit grade A/B/C and the reason each one fits) from trade records and the public web, plus a link to the saved report on reevi.ai where the exporter can unlock contacts and send introductions. Takes 30 to 75 seconds. Free: 5 searches a day.

product.description: What the exporter sells, in plain words, e.g. 'organic turmeric powder' or 'stainless steel kitchen sinks'.

target_markets.description: Countries to find buyers in, as full English names (e.g. 'Germany', 'United States'). Defaults to the US, UK and Germany.

company_name.description: The exporter's company name, when known. Improves the fit.

company_country.description: Where the exporter is based. Buyers in that country are left out.

customer_types.description: Which kind of buyer the exporter sells to.

exclude_domains.description: Websites of buyers already found, to get new ones on a second search.
